transcript: Someone just launched a free dashboard similar to what governments use for surveillance and it's called World Monitor. You can open it in your browser and see what's happening right now all around the globe. And you can even filter it down to your region of interest. Not only that, but you can also toggle on multiple layers and watch military activity, trade routes, or even see natural disasters like earthquake and wildfires caught by NASA satellites. There's also a panel for live webcams and broadcasts where you can choose between multiple news channels for each country, like BBC, CNN playing at the same time. But here's the craziest part. There are six versions right inside the dashboard like world, tech, finance, and even a happy monitor that shows only good news around the world. And you can even connect this monitor to your ChatGPT or Claude to investigate further. If you want a link to this website, it's pinned in the comment section.
